messages.content: Help me handle surrogate pairs in XML serialization, specifically for a high surrogate value of 55357 and a low surrogate value of 56832, when the content is not within a CDATA section?

function.name: BaseMarkupSerializer_surrogates

high.description: The high surrogate value of the surrogate pair. This is Java integer type parameter in string representation.

low.description: The low surrogate value of the surrogate pair. This is Java integer type parameter in string representation.

inContent.description: A flag indicating whether the surrogate pair is within XML content. This is Java boolean type parameter in string representation.
